title: Hailey Bieber’s Sold-Out Gap Jeans Have Affordable $15 Old Navy Dupes
summary: If you missed the sold-out "Hailey Jean" drop, these denim dupes recreate the celebrity-loved baggy jean look.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Hailey Bieber has long been known for her love of denim. The model, entrepreneur and wife of Grammy-winning singer Justin Bieber is frequently spotted wearing relaxed, low-slung jeans, making her a natural fit for Gap’s latest celebrity collaboration . The brand teamed up with Bieber on the “Hailey Jean” capsule, a limited-edition collection that quickly became a viral fashion moment and sold out within minutes of launching.

For fans who missed the drop, Old Navy has affordable denim alternatives that tap into a similar relaxed aesthetic. The retailer is part of Gap Inc., the same parent company behind Gap, making it another destination for shoppers looking for denim styles at a lower price point.

MOST AFFORDABLE

Old Navy High-Waisted Baggy Wide-Leg Jeans

$14.99 $44.99 67% off

Buy Now at Old Navy

On clearance for 70% off.

The original “Hailey Jean” may have a low-rise fit, but this Old Navy alternative taps into the same ’90s-inspired baggy denim trend with a high-rise waist and relaxed leg. Crafted without stretch, the jeans offer a structured feel similar to the oversized silhouette that made Gap’s capsule go viral. The cotton-blend pair is made with 63% cotton, 32% Tencel lyocell and 5% recycled cotton, from the same Gap Inc. brand family.

MID-RISE FIT

Old Navy Mid-Rise Wow Baggy Wide-Leg Jeans

$26 $39.99 35% off

Available in four denim washes.

Ringing up at only $26, Old Navy’s Wow Baggy Wide-Leg Jeans deliver the ’90s slouch shoppers are looking for. Available in sizes 00 to 30 with short, regular and long inseam options, the jeans offer a versatile fit for different heights and body types. The super-baggy thigh creates a comfortable, relaxed silhouette, while the mid-rise waist sits just below the belly button.

DENIM DUPE

Old Navy Low-Rise Baggy Wide-Leg Jeans

$43.99 $54.99 20% off

A low-rise supper baggy denim alternative.

For a denim alternative that comes close to the viral baggy jean look, this pair checks all the boxes. The low-rise waistband sits on the hips, while the extra-baggy thigh creates the relaxed ’90s silhouette shoppers are after. Offered in regular, tall and petite fits, the no-stretch jeans are crafted from a blend of 63% cotton, 32% lyocell and 5% recycled cotton. Plus, the under-$50 price makes them a budget-friendly pick.

VINTAGE-INSPIRED

Old Navy Low-Rise Loose Jeans

$32.39 $44.99 28% off

A relaxed low-rise silhouette that sits comfortably on the hips.

With the “Hailey Low-Rise Loose Jean” sold out, this Old Navy style from the same Gap Inc. family is one of the closest alternatives. It has the same relaxed, loose silhouette with a low-rise waist that sits comfortably on the hips and a longer inseam that creates a subtle puddled hem. Available in five denim washes and sizes 00 to 30, this pair is fully stocked. If you prefer a more tailored fit over the signature ’90s slouch, consider sizing down.

HIGHLY-RATED

Old Navy High-Waisted Wow Loose Jeans

$26 $36.99 30% off

These comfortable, highly rated jeans are 30% off.

For shoppers who prefer high-stretch denim, this highly-rated Old Navy pair is on sale for just $26. Made from 62% cotton, 30% recycled polyester, 7% recycled cotton and 1% spandex, it offers a comfortable fit with plenty of flexibility. Similar to the viral Loose Jean, this relaxed style comes in five denim washes and is fully stocked in every size.

Inspired by Gap’s ’90s denim styles, which Bieber has previously named among her favorites, the “Hailey Jean” collection features two low-rise silhouettes: the Extra Baggy and the Low-Rise Loose. Both styles were inspired by 1996, the year Bieber was born, and come in three washes: light indigo, medium indigo and midnight indigo. Each pair originally retailed for $89.

Shop 'tHE hAILEY jEAN' gAP coLLAB

Bieber celebrated the launch on Instagram with photos of herself wearing the jeans, soundtracked by “Linger” by ’90s alternative band The Cranberries , highlighting the nostalgic influence behind the collection. The collaboration also reflects the continued popularity of ’90s fashion trends, from oversized denim to low-rise silhouettes.

While the original ‘Hailey Jean’ collection is sold out, these $15+ Old Navy denim picks offer a similar baggy fit and vintage-inspired feel. They’re an affordable way to recreate Bieber’s viral denim look without waiting for a restock.
